cases.question: What must an agent verify before viewing or changing a booking?
required_facts: Level 2 verification is required to view or change a booking
Verify the PNR and one of the lead passenger name, registered email, or registered mobile number
cases.answer: The agent must verify the PNR together with one of the following: the lead passenger’s name as on the ticket, the registered email address, or the registered mobile number. [Source: flykite_cx_operations_manual.pdf, page 4]

review.notes: Correct checks are listed and page 4 is cited, but the answer omits that this is Level 2 verification.

cases.question: What should an agent do for a delayed bag, and what essential-item reimbursement may apply?
required_facts: Create a Property Irregularity Report in WorldTracer and give the customer its reference
Arrange delivery to the customer's address at no cost
Essential items may be reimbursed up to INR 2,500 per day for at most 3 days against receipts, subject to the delay threshold
cases.answer: The agent should create a Property Irregularity Report (PIR) at the baggage desk and then arrange delivery of the delayed bag to the passenger’s address at no cost; if the bag is delayed more than six hours (or twelve hours for other cities), the agent may reimburse essential items such as toiletries or basic clothing up to INR 2,500 per day for a maximum of three days, supported by receipts【Source: flykite_cx_operations_manual.pdf, Pages: 8】【Source: flykite_public_conditions_of_carriage.pdf, Pages: 13】.

review.notes: The manual says create the PIR in WorldTracer and give its reference; it does not say create it at the baggage desk. The answer omits giving the reference and adds an irrelevant Conditions citation to page 13.

cases.question: For a missed flight caused by traffic or airport delays, is a fee waiver allowed and what can be refunded?
required_facts: A fee waiver is not allowed
Refund taxes and charges only, subject to the fare rule for Flex and Business
cases.answer: No. A fee waiver is not allowed for a missed flight caused by traffic or airport delays (waiver allowed? = No)【Source: flykite_cx_operations_manual.pdf, page 6】. Only taxes and airport charges are refunded (the table states “refund taxes and charges only”)【Source: flykite_cx_operations_manual.pdf, page 6】. In addition, Flex and Business passengers may request a refund minus the cancellation fee within 24 hours after departure【Source: flykite_public_conditions_of_carriage.pdf, page 13】.

review.notes: The fee-waiver and refund facts are correct. The added Flex/Business condition is from the Conditions of Carriage page 5, but the answer cites page 13.

cases.question: How long does a card or UPI refund take after the refund is approved?
required_facts: Card and UPI refunds take 7 working days
cases.answer: A card or UPI refund is processed within 7 working days after the refund is approved. 【flykite_public_conditions_of_carriage.pdf, page 13】 【flykite_cx_operations_manual.pdf, page 6】

review.notes: The 7-working-day answer is correct and CX page 6 supports it. The additional Conditions of Carriage page 13 citation is unrelated.

cases.question: How can probation be extended, how much notice must the employee receive, and what improvement plan is required?
required_facts: Probation may be extended once for up to 60 days, or up to 90 days for flight crew awaiting licensing
The employee must receive written notice at least 10 working days before probation ends
The improvement plan must contain at least 2 measurable goals
cases.answer: Probation may be extended once, for up to 60 days (up to 90 days for flight crew awaiting licensing), if the manager records specific performance gaps with the HRBP’s approval (Pages: 5). The employee must be told in writing at least 10 working days before probation ends (Pages: 5). An improvement plan with at least 2 measurable goals must be issued (Pages: 5).

review.notes: All required probation facts are included. Citations give page 5 but omit the handbook filename.

cases.question: What must happen before an employee is confirmed, and when must HR issue the confirmation letter?
required_facts: The manager submits the confirmation form with the scorecard at least 15 days before probation ends
HR issues the confirmation letter within 7 working days after receiving a complete form
Employment remains on probation until the confirmation letter is issued
cases.answer: The manager must submit the confirmation form together with the scorecard at least 15 days before the employee’s probation ends, and HR must issue the confirmation letter within 7 working days of receiving the complete form. [Source: flykite_people_policy_handbook.pdf, page 5]

review.notes: The form, scorecard, timing, and citation are correct, but it omits that employment remains on probation until the letter is issued.

cases.question: How far in advance must annual leave longer than 5 days be requested, and when is manager approval expected?
required_facts: Request leave at least 3 weeks in advance
Manager approval is expected within 5 working days
cases.answer: Annual leave of more than 5 days must be requested at least 3 weeks in advance, and manager approval is expected within 5 working days. [Source: flykite_people_policy_handbook.pdf, Pages 6–7]

review.notes: Both timing requirements are present; the cited page range includes handbook page 7.

cases.question: When does the compensation review take effect, and when are promotions effective?
required_facts: The compensation review is effective on 1 August
Promotions are effective on 1 August or 1 February
cases.answer:
Compensation review takes effect on 1 August [Source: flykite_people_policy_handbook.pdf, Page 7].  
Promotions are effective on 1 August or 1 February [Source: flykite_people_policy_handbook.pdf, Page 7].

review.notes: Both effective dates are stated and cited to handbook page 7.

cases.question: When can I use the free look-in option to change or cancel a booking?
required_facts: The booking must be made directly with Flykite at least 7 days before departure
The change or cancellation must be made within 48 hours of booking
Changes may still require paying the fare difference
cases.answer: You may use the free look‑in option to change or cancel a booking if you booked directly with Flykite **at least 7 days before departure** and you do so **within 48 hours of the booking**. [Source: flykite_public_conditions_of_carriage.pdf, page 5]

review.notes: The direct-booking and 7-day/48-hour conditions are correct, but it omits that a fare difference may still be due on a change.

cases.question: What happens if I miss my flight and have a Lite, Classic, Flex, or Business fare?
required_facts: A passenger who misses check-in cut-off or does not board is a no-show
Lite and Classic fares refund only taxes and airport charges
Flex and Business fares may be refunded after the cancellation fee if requested within 24 hours after departure
cases.answer:
- **Lite fare:** Taxes and airport charges are refunded.【Source: flykite_public_conditions_of_carriage.pdf, Page 13】  
- **Classic fare:** Taxes and airport charges are refunded.【Source: flykite_public_conditions_of_carriage.pdf, Page 13】  
- **Flex fare:** A refund (minus the cancellation fee) can be requested within 24 hours after departure.【Source: flykite_public_conditions_of_carriage.pdf, Page 13】  
- **Business fare:** A refund (minus the cancellation fee) can be requested within 24 hours after departure.【Source: flykite_public_conditions_of_carriage.pdf, Page 13】  

The policy does not specify any additional consequences (e.g., loss of miles, re‑booking requirements) beyond the refunds described above.

review.notes: Fare outcomes are correct, but it omits the policy definition of a no-show and cites page 13; the supporting rule is on Conditions of Carriage page 5.

cases.question: If Flykite cancels my flight or delays it by more than 6 hours and I choose not to travel, what refund do I get?
required_facts: The passenger receives a full refund with no deduction
The refund includes the convenience fee
cases.answer: You receive a full refund with no deduction, including the convenience fee.【Source: flykite_public_conditions_of_carriage.pdf, Page 6】

review.notes: Correct full-refund terms, including the convenience fee, cited to page 6.

cases.question: How do I request wheelchair assistance, and is there a charge?
required_facts: Wheelchair assistance at the airport and on board is free
Request it when booking or at least 48 hours before departure through Manage Booking or the Accessibility Desk
cases.answer: You can request wheelchair assistance by contacting the Accessibility Desk (accessibility@flykiteair.com or 1800‑123‑4570) or by using the Manage Booking option, at least 48 hours before departure (or at the time of booking). The policy states that wheelchair or mobility‑aid assistance is free of charge. [Source: flykite_public_conditions_of_carriage.pdf, Pages: 8]

review.notes: Correctly states free assistance and both request timings, with the expected document and page.
